title: 第29章 认识的人多啊
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
几兄弟就这么聊了起来。

    李西海跟李西飞的接触并不多，他是邻县的李姓。

    逢年过节可能会见到，但很少很少。

    从李西海祖祖这一辈算，李西飞的爹还在五服之内，但李西飞却是在五服之外了。

    不管。

    他们这群西字辈的，倒是没想那么多。

    照面的时候，该是兄弟是兄弟。

    毕竟，都在一个市，还认的都是一个祖祠。

    家族关系是要顺着走，认这份家族辈分的。

    正说着，杜鸿就带着之前几个起冲突的经销商过来。

    态度很是诚恳，喝了赔罪的酒，杜鸿表示今天李西海的消费，由他来买单。

    这事就算是揭过了。

    但李西雄却对买单的事不买账。

    “我们可不是掏不起钱的。”

    “敢来玩，就消费得起。”

    李西雄想法很简单，“毕竟也是十几万，到时候传出去，我们是在欺负人。”

    杜鸿赔笑，道：“哥，这是应该的，毕竟是他们不守规矩，没管好自己的手。”

    “我知道，事归事，理归理。”

    李西雄虽然喝醉了，但思路还是很清晰。

    李西英叼着烟，搂着果盘，也是说道：“赔罪，我们接受了。”

    “买单就算了。”

    李西海道：“就这样吧杜鸿。”

    李西飞也道：“我哥都这么说，那这次就算了。”

    杜鸿无奈的笑了笑，其他人赔笑弯腰着，只好出去。

    “你看看，这送钱送出去，人家都不稀罕得要。”

    杜鸿摇头。

    “杜总，这几个人跟李总关系这么亲近的？”

    一个经销商问道：“我看李总在他们面前，似乎真就跟弟弟一样？”

    “不然呢？”

    杜鸿没好气的说道：“车展的事估计不会有问题。”

    “你们要是不知道他们什么情况。”

    “自己去打听打听江云李姓。”

    “李总不是跟你们开玩笑，要是在江云，你们别想再干这行了。”

    ……

    另外一头。

    会所经理正在往上汇报情况。

    本来客人之间起冲突，这点小事没必要惊动上面的。

    但杜鸿请的人，虽然是第一次来，但从身边的果盘口中了解到，其实身份不简单。

    “万总，就是这样。”

    “他们亲自过去赔罪。”

    “四个人，很横。”

    “姓李！”

    “是，是叫杜鸿！”

    “明白。”
content_en:
The brothers just started chatting.

    Li Xihai didn't have much contact with Li Xifei. He was from a neighboring county with the surname Li.

    You may see them during the holidays, but rarely.

    Counting from Li Xihai's ancestor's generation, Li Xifei's father is still within the fifth server, but Li Xifei is outside the fifth server.

    in spite of.

    They, the Western generation, didn’t think much about it.

    When we meet, we should be brothers.

    After all, they are all in the same city, and they all recognize the same ancestral temple.

    Family relationships should be followed along and recognized as the family's seniority.

    Just as he was talking, Du Hong came over with several dealers who had had conflicts before.

    His attitude was very sincere. After drinking the apology wine, Du Hong said that he would pay for Li Xihai's consumption today.

    This matter has been revealed.

    But Li Xixiong didn't accept the matter of footing the bill.

    "It's not like we can't afford it."

    “If you dare to come and play, you can afford it.”

    Li Xixiong's idea is simple, "After all, it's only hundreds of thousands. When word gets out, we will be bullying others."

    Du Hong smiled apologetically and said, "Brother, this is as it should be. After all, they were the ones who didn't follow the rules and didn't take care of their own hands."

    "I know, things will fall into place and things will fall into place."

    Although Li Xixiong was drunk, his thoughts were still very clear.

    Li Xiying held a cigarette in her mouth and hugged the fruit plate, and also said: "We accept the apology."

    "Just pay the bill."

    Li Xihai said: "That's it, Du Hong."

    Li Xifei also said: "My brother said so, so let's forget it this time."

    Du Hong smiled helplessly, while the others bowed down and had no choice but to go out.

    "Look, if you give away money, people won't be surprised to ask for it."

    Du Hong shook his head.

    "Mr. Du, are these people so close to Mr. Li?"

    A dealer asked: "It seems to me that Mr. Li is really just like his younger brother in front of them?"

    "What if?"

    Du Hong said angrily: "I don't think there will be any problems with the car show."

    "If you don't know what's going on with them."

    "Go and find out Jiang Yun's surname yourself."

    "Mr. Li is not joking with you. If we are in Jiangyun, you will never want to do this again."

    …

    The other end.

    The club manager is reporting the situation to the top.

    Originally, there was a conflict between the guests, so there was no need to alarm the higher-ups over such a trivial matter.

    But although the person Du Hong invited came here for the first time, he learned from the fruit bowl around him that his identity was not simple.

    "Mr. Wan, that's it."

    "They went over in person to apologize."

    "Four people, very rough."

    "The last name is Li!"

    "Yes, it's Du Hong!"

    "Understood."
title_en: Chapter 29 I know a lot of people
